notes.title: Store Page Localization + ESA July
notes.content:
In early March, we updated the demo to Version 0.7, which set the stage for us in what the game will truly feel like on release. Since then, the progress has been climbing, but we're happy to release our newly localized Steam store page!




English
Chinese (Simplified)
Russian
Portuguese
Hungarian


We'll be adding more as we get translators in on the job.

In other news, we love speed running! We're big speed run enthusiasts, so we've decided to attend the European Speedrunning Assembly held in Malmö, Sweden this July. Although we applied our game's demo for a spot to run, we didn't make the cut, sadly. That being said, we will still be attending, watching speedruns, and hopefully still sharing our game with fellow con goers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919867/f7fd4f3c6da03705be7be752afc28a34cf0784a9.png

The Progress Report:

And finally, for those interested in surveying the progress of Odyssey, here's a short list of what we've been up to:

[olist]
Day/Night and Weather
We've spent more time tying the game's real-time day/night and weather conditions into more meaningful gameplay opportunities.

Weather and moon cycles are tracked in the game's menu which you can look at any time during gameplay. NPCs and creatures in the overworld react to weather, altering their schedule, and in most monsters' case, affecting their spawn rate.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919867/0b80ad6150f737ad78f493229aeb5c4ff22afb99.png
The weather UI, the icons (from leftmost to rightmost) indicate the weather, the time of day, and moon cycle.

Your loyal party members are also affected by the weather. Each party member has a "God Sign" which is influenced by the weather! These unique buffs will give them specific edge in a fight, so plan accordingly to maximize your party!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919867/8360ec69e09d79a9b61f595e23d819e75bfe4494.png

The in-game Glossary
This one's still pretty early in development for us, but take a look regardless!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919867/fb84838c5efff8f1c09c0c74579d63bc993c4ff2.png
It's a long way off, but the glossary brings all of game's data to the forefront for avid studies to look at any time. Most of this data was already cached in the game's resource files, so we're mostly just building an interface to bind it all together for player convenience.

The Glossary keeps track of party members, NPCs, enemies, bosses, quests, items, recipes, it does it ALL. We also promise there will be fruitful rewards for players who keep tabs on all of the things they uncover with it.

Even MORE Visual Overhauls

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919867/360714432de461d0f1cbe2ff58be3fa7eba25358.png

As our artwork continues to improve, we continue to go back, and repave some of our rockier older spritework. This does take a lot of time, but the results are absolutely worth it. There's easily been more than 90-100 frames of animation reworked by this point.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919867/438e406b544a224a47297964af4155f24d449e14.png
[/olist]

Thanks for keeping up with us, if you're interested in playtesting new versions of the demo, reach out to us via the Steam forums! See you soon!

notes.title: The New Official Trailer + Demo V0.7
notes.content:
When we attended Steam Next Fest in June, 2023, we had no clue just how novice we really were; our trail was hot, and needed to be even hotter, but it was the greatest trip we'd ever had in terms of engaging an audience, and receiving feedback on what we had developed -- it was still everything we hoped for and more. Since then, it's been about ~8 months, and we haven't stopped chugging away! To show off our progress, we're ecstatic to launch our brand new trailer!

[previewyoutube=OnhjeM9dAIk;full][/previewyoutube]

We've also been incredibly active on our social medias, heavily documenting our game dev progress, and sharing our hard learned lessons along the way; you can also check out our "Making of" series on our Youtube page while checking out the trailer for an in-depth look at what our development has been like!

Demo V0.7

We realize our game isn't a routinely updated/played multiplayer game, but we still enjoy updating our demo when we can, as we think transparency, and giving anyone new a chance to play a superior experience is important. We would be here all day if I listed every change in the new demo version, so I'll highlight a couple things to monument our progress:


Overhauled Day/Night, now environment/NPCs react to time of day
Most characters/environments have been visually updated/completely redrawn (looks much better)
Overhauled item balance, added more items
Updated cinematics for a much better experience (Some voice acting may now be missing as new lines haven't been recorded by the actors yet)
More streamlined combat, easier and more polished playing experience
Menus are more organized, and display better information about abilities/items
More optional dialogue with NPC's to engage with
Added a couple of new achievements


These changes may seem very "general", but they are all a key to creating the best overall product as possible. Worry not, for we've also addressed many small bugs/niche problems that have been observed, too.
We're in our stride, however, since we're such a small team, we've decided to push our release date back a final time: April, 2025. Good luck, and happy hunting the new demo achievements!

notes.title: Odyssey Kickstarter Campaign is LIVE!
notes.content:
It's been a long road to get here, but we're ecstatic to announce that our Kickstarter campaign is live! From Sept 19 - October 19th, you can head over to our KICKSTARTER PAGE and see everything we have to offer!

Why Should you Support us?

We'd like to say that TRUE art inspires patronage -- but that usually gets me in trouble at the bank. So here's a couple great rewards you can get when you help us out on this campaign:

First up is that you can back the game for as little as $15, and receive a digital copy on release (that's a 25% discount!).

Going up, you can get rewards ranging from any paid DLC we make (Which we are currently planning for), beta access, a chance to influence small bits of content in the game, and even a physical design sheet of the game's spritework (since everything is drawn on paper). We have even more, so you should most definitely check it out!

We project that with our campaign's funding goal, we'll have no issue releasing a great hit around this time October next year; and that crowdfunding will keep our autonomy in tact while we work at what we do best!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919867/da73f2d7d73b1c354e2620076632c0af6edc5bc7.png

We've also been pushing small patches to our demo! We've overall been striving to create more stable, better performing -- and more FUN version of the game than ever before.

Once the crowdfunding campaign dies down, we'll be back to updating bugs/incomplete features as we see fit, but for now, this will be taking up a lot of our time and resources.


[previewyoutube=WHMWOMTDW68;full][/previewyoutube]


Remember to check out our Kickstarter!

notes.title: Our Kickstarter Campaign + Speedrun Mode update (V0.6)
notes.content:
The time is nigh! After a long, arduous period; with much anxiety, we at Chiaroscuro are announcing our KICKSTARTER CAMPAIGN!

Our Kickstarter offers a lot of great goodies for our supporters, including a discount on the game, and greater discounts on whatever content the game provides in the future. Furthermore, we have rewards for the digital release of art books, soundtracks -- and a physical reward consisting of the actual game's design pages (This is a big deal since the entire game's sprite work is drawn on paper with pencil).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919867/85f0bd25e8a5d2f1419cb0e186c7825767fb204d.png

In other news, we've released Version 0.6 for the demo! This features a fair amount of small bug fixes, but the pièce de résistance is our new SPEEDRUN MODE

The speedrun mode can be toggled via the pause menu at any time, we recommend toggling it at the start of a game, signifying a run. The mode toggles an in-game timer, and there's a "reset" option which quickly restarts your game progress to reset a run.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919867/bfeaf67fd8ec821e62fce70b7fd418f887cfa083.png

You can also submit your speedrun directly to speedrun.com, too. We hope to see you on the leaderboard for the demo run!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919867/b7eb01bff20ed22ff3af4208e74a8b972c8ac9d1.png

CONSIDER SUPPORTING US WHEN THE CAMPAIGN BEGINS SEPTEMBER 19th!

notes.title: The Definitive Demo Release!
notes.content:
Odyssey of Dremid'ir has been in development for longer than two years, and has been (bearably playable) for about half of that time. In that period, we've now released 5 major demo version updates, of which we are pleased to announce that THIS is the most definitive version, and what you can largely anticipate the full game (more or less) controlling like. Before going further into what our next step is about, let us quickly cap what's inside the Version 0.5 update:



Menu Overhauls including:
 Better allocation of stats (exp, items, etc)
 Equipment now has a layout, showing what's worn
 Attributes/Abilities (and exp) are now represented by icons
 Abilities that are unavailable/locked are now darkened
 There's now a new mouse cursor!
 Gear now displays an icon for who can wear it (Warrior/Ranger/Spellcaster)

Several reworked particle effects
New particle system for when landing attacks/spells
Party members now stand differently in battle, respondent to their target 
There are now three damage types (Physical/Magical/Pure) as opposed to just one type

Reworked Combat HUD
 Entirely new graphical UI
 Rotating/targeting allies/enemies is much easier/more responsive
 Descriptions, and statistics of attacks/abilities/enemies are now displayed
 Boss enemies now have a shiny new HP bar
 HUD shrinks away when not in use (more clarity in combat)
 Icons/coloured text is displayed when debuffed by something

New area including a new side quest/boss (We anticipate uploading 0.5a with the rest of the missing VA)
New enemies
Fast Travel fires now display a world map
Fast Travel fires now also allow you to wait until a certain time of day (it also heals)

Smaller bug fixes include:
Frightening Leer no longer crashes
Player collisions no longer clip in certain areas
Various map polishing
Added various new animations for certain characters
Loading a conversation does not cause nearly as much game stutter
Fast Travel menu text is no longer oddly blurry
Inner Fire's power bonus is no longer permanent
Re-added "Last Action" command in battle (it no longer causes crashes)
Abilities should now deal more damage on average (as they are meant to)


With our first TRUE monumental milestone cleared, we're ready to set sail for the remainder of our game development. This means creating the remaining content that will not appear in the demo; generating more buzz, and getting ready for our crowdfunding campaign! We've decided to settle up with Kickstarter to run our campaign, for a simple 10,000 USD. If you're interested in supporting us, and seeing the game all the way through, please keep an eye out for our campaign. You can follow the campaign RIGHT HERE!

[previewyoutube=na4o96hmmMo;full][/previewyoutube]
If you're too busy to read, check out our video to see most of what I've mentioned at play!

Remember to post about your bugs and experiences! We would love to hear them!

notes.title: DEVBLOG I
notes.content:
From our talented Programmer, Adam:

Hey all! We had been fighting with the shadows the last half a year or so, never really coming to a solution. We wanted to provide the absolute best and use fully dynamically-shaped shadows. After MANY (and I mean it) tries, it always had something going wrong. FYI, Godot 3.x has absolutely no built-in support for this kind of stuff at the precision we were attempting to reach.

The tediousness of this dynamic shadow system was probably the biggest bottleneck in our progression. And to top that off, I've always felt like we won't ever get to the end of it this way. Something was just always missing from working 100% functionally. So yesterday I proposed we actually bite the bullet and stop clinging to it. We never had to do anything like this with any game code that had a fair amount of effort put into it, so it was hard to actually eject the concept.

And so, last night, we came to a compromise to just use black dots and stretch them arbitrarily, based on the character/prop we're depicting.

We went from this:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919867/fe4a10fe7fac95d742536791edb153d40fedf8c2.png

Dynamic shaders aim to depict shadows - Imagine if we also used them on trees! Yeah, it would look off if we didn't hand-pick each one's offsets, even with a better modulated shadow.

TO THIS:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42919867/4ee63b913ba42b7ed3d2f00be9771fafccf04f96.png

Arbitrarily stretched spheres represent shadows

Unfortunately for us, Godot 3.x doesn't have complete support for directional shadows that conform to the sprite, thus we had all the trial and error to try and make it work. But eventually, maybe this new solution is better, as we had no consistent methodology to like, display shadows above ground props like a rock.

This means, if we passed by a rock, the shadow would partially be covered by it. And yeah, that's quite unacceptable to begin with. I don't wanna get too technical, but some character sprites/animations would've also required unique rotations, scales and offsets for their shadows. AND even then, it wouldn't work from every angle.

We really wanted to pioneer the visual world while having Godot 3.x as a tool help us, but one can't always have it all. Sometimes you gotta let go of things if they don't work out, and find alternatives. That's what we did, and recreated this shadow system with like 5-10% of the time cost our old shadows consumed.

Thanks for giving this a read, I hope it was as worthy as for me to get this out of my head. If you wanna know more about our game, please pay our Discord a visit :) We're gonna look for testers shortly, and it'd be awesome to have you around!

Have you ever had any similar situations where you were overly biased to keep a feature that has given you enough hard times? How did you overcome it?

By the way, we're still planning to release a pretty comprehensive demo for STEAM NEXT FEST THIS JUNE!
But if you would like to test what we've been up to lately, we have just released a new demo today!

GRAB THE DEMO HERE!
